_comment: Quiz category rotation and topic rules (Giulia, 10 Nov 2026). The weekly run picks each week's 3 quizzes from here and adds a history entry for every quiz it makes.
rules: Go round the rotation in order; never the same category twice in a row.

Fandom = one franchise people love (e.g. Friends, Stranger Things, Harry Potter, Disney, Pokemon). Research each week which fandoms people love and search for right now (vidIQ, YouTube trends, channel data).
A topic (fandom, franchise, show, film series, band, sport, etc.) is not repeated within 365 days of its last quiz.
Family-friendly only: never anything sexual, graphic, hateful or otherwise inappropriate. Pick topics that suit a general audience on a quiz channel.
Education = a school topic (e.g. a Victorian Curriculum science unit for Years 7-12).
Fandom quizzes are hard; others medium unless the analytics say otherwise (Giulia: Quiz #10 felt hard; report on retention).
